title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in impleCode…
description: A reflected Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in impleCode eCommerce Product Catalog versions up to 3.6.4. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling attackers to execute malicious scripts in the context of a user's browser session.
